subject: Check-in anchoring and goal transfer for Q4 review
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood-inference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Megan Lin <megan@peopleops.co>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acme-cloud.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Q4: Manager notes + goal transfer

Folks —

I'm consolidating manager notes ahead of the Q4 check-ins and need a small cross-team decision on how we anchor scores so HR and Eng Leadership can reconcile the handback later this week. Two asks:

1) Please review the attached workbook ("checkins_Q4_2026.xlsx") — the first tab has raw manager comments, the second tab is a proposed anonymized handback.
2) Read the short doc ("goal_transfer_notes.md") for a suggested flow when goals move between managers (we have two transfers this cycle: Priya -> Rishi, and Daniela -> Tom's group).

Quick context: the platform team wants to keep a consistent 5-point anchoring but there are tensions on how stretch OKRs should map to manager ratings. I flagged a few sensitive comments that may need redaction before HR sees them (see comments column).

Can we align on: (a) the rubric to apply for "stretch" vs "core" objectives, and (b) whether we anonymize manager comments prior to the HR upload?

Target: finalize by EOD Thursday so People Ops can start ingestion Friday morning.

Attachments: [Attachment: checkins_Q4_2026.xlsx (XLSX, 152KB)], [Attachment: goal_transfer_notes.md (MD, 4KB)]

Thanks —
Jasmine Liu
Senior Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood-inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Megan Lin <megan@peopleops.co>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q4: Manager notes + goal transfer

On Mon, Dec 6, 2026 at 9:14 AM Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood-inference.com> wrote:
> Folks —
> 
> I'm consolidating manager notes ahead of the Q4 check-ins and need a small cross-team decision on how we anchor scores so HR and Eng Leadership can reconcile the handback later this week. Two asks:
> 
> 1) Please review the attached workbook ("checkins_Q4_2026.xlsx") — the first tab has raw manager comments, the second tab is a proposed anonymized handback.
> 2) Read the short doc ("goal_transfer_notes.md") for a suggested flow when goals move between managers (we have two transfers this cycle: Priya -> Rishi, and Daniela -> Tom's group).
> 
> Quick context: the platform team wants to keep a consistent 5-point anchoring but there are tensions on how stretch OKRs should map to manager ratings. I flagged a few sensitive comments that may need redaction before HR sees them (see comments column).
> 
> Can we align on: (a) the rubric to apply for "stretch" vs "core" objectives, and (b) whether we anonymize manager comments prior to the HR upload?
> 
> Target: finalize by EOD Thursday so People Ops can start ingestion Friday morning.

Thanks for pulling this together, Jasmine. I took a pass through the workbook and added inline comments on rows where wording could be interpreted as performance commentary vs. project context. Two quick notes from my side: 

- I suggest we anonymize manager-level narrative for any case with open performance conversations or PIP history — Megan, can you confirm if People Ops needs the raw manager text to validate process compliance, or is anonymized acceptable for the initial ingest?
- For goal transfers: the transfer doc looks good, but add a requirement that the receiving manager acknowledges the incoming OKR by replying on the handback row (stamp with timestamp) so we have an audit trail.

Proposed small change: use a 1-5 anchor where 3 = meets expectations and 4 = exceeds consistently (not a partial). That will make rollups less fuzzy.

I attached an anonymized export (see below) — I removed free-text comments that reference private coaching conversations.

Attachments: [Attachment: checkins_Q4_2026_anonymized.xlsx (XLSX, 97KB)]

Laura
Director of Engineering, Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood-inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Dec 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q4: Manager notes + goal transfer

Thanks — a couple of practical suggestions from the calibration side: 

- Scoring rubric: adopt 1..5 with explicit examples per score (I pasted three examples into the Drive doc linked below). This will reduce manager variance.
- Calibration slot: let's block a 30-min slot Thursday 15:00-15:30 PT for a tight review; if that doesn't work, Friday 09:00-09:30 PT. I can host.
- Sensitive items: agree with Laura — any line referencing medical/leave or private coaching needs full redaction before HR ingest. For anything else, redaction + anonymization is fine.

Drive with examples: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-checkins-q4-2026

Vivek
VP, Engineering

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood-inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Megan Lin <megan@peopleops.co>
Date: Thu, 9 Dec 2026 07:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q4: Manager notes + goal transfer

Agree with the plan. Quick heads-up from People Ops intake: if we anonymize first, they will ask for the underscored metadata (date of conversation, who the manager was) in a separate secure file for audit. Megan — if you can confirm the minimum fields we must keep separately, that will help us avoid repeated redactions.

Also — for the two transfers, I recommend a one-paragraph transfer summary inserted into the receiving manager's OKR row so context travels with the goal (not buried in comments).

Short availability for calibration: Thursday 15:00-15:30 PT works for me.

Marissa
Head of People Ops (interim)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood-inference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Megan Lin <megan@peopleops.co>
Date: Thu, 9 Dec 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q4: Manager notes + goal transfer

Perfect — thanks, everyone.

Plan agreed:
- Use 1..5 anchor with 3 = meets; Vivek will upload three concrete examples to the Drive for reference.
- Laura will produce the anonymized workbook for initial ingest; Marissa will confirm the separate audit fields People Ops needs.
- Calibration call: Thu 15:00-15:30 PT (calendar invite sent).
- For goal transfers: receiving manager to add a timestamped acknowledgment line and a 1-paragraph summary in the OKR row.

I'll update goal_transfer_notes.md with the timestamp requirement and push the final workbook to the Drive folder. Megan — if you can confirm the minimum audit fields by EOD Friday, we'll be set.

Attachments: [Attachment: goal_transfer_notes.md (updated)]

Thanks —
Jasmine
Senior Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference
